MEASURED_2026_09_11_UPDATE.not_done: no contract change, no relaxation of the 1,260 s limit, no selection of the friendliest base among the three, and no argument that the refusal is wrong. MEASURED_2026_09_11_UPDATE.the_real_finding: this ratio cannot be measured by SEQUENTIAL runs on a shared box. The quantity it must resolve is a candidate whose true decode delta is about zero -- same 117,964,800 symbol decodes, a 603 B SMALLER model, an EMPTY scoped receiver delta -- and the instrument's own noise on identical bytes is 20.9 pct, an order of magnitude larger. Every sequential number here is a property of the window it ran in.

three_measurements_of_the_same_base_arch.verdict: the SAME bytes decode 20.9 pct apart depending on when the run starts. The box's load fell from ~20 to ~10 between this arm's candidate leg and its base leg.

action_taken: a fresh base diagnostic on move 44's promoted tree -- the t4_direct leg's own runtime, whose receiver digest 7e6da183 is what the contract requires of a base -- launched in this arm's window with the same fleet live (load 14, pc3 at four processes). Both legs then share one set of conditions.
axis: [macOS-CPU advisory; local diagnostics, never timing authority]
finding: the prefire risk ratio's BASE leg is not transferable across measurement windows. Using pc3's base_move44 diagnostic as this arm's denominator projects 1,394.199 s and REFUSES the 1,260 s policy limit; the numerator and denominator were measured under different fleet load, so the ratio is a property of two windows rather than of two archives.
genus: cross-regime constant transfer: a constant measured at one window's scope, re-used at another's. The contract is right to refuse -- an unmatched ratio is not evidence -- and the cure is to MEASURE the base leg in this arm's own window, not to argue the numerator down.
not_done: no contract change, no relaxation of the 1,260 s limit, and no argument that the refusal was wrong. If the matched ratio still projects over the limit, that is a real finding about this candidate and it stops here.
why_the_13_percent_is_not_the_candidate: the candidate's HPAC section is 603 B SMALLER and its tail 358 B larger, but the arithmetic decoder performs the SAME 117,964,800 symbol decodes either way -- decode work is per symbol, not per byte of code. A 13% change in decode time cannot come from that, and the scoped receiver delta between the two trees is EMPTY (0 differing rows). What differs is the box.
